strings.hero.title: Start with a place to belong.
strings.hero.body: One home for identity, conversations and memory. Choose your language and appearance to get started.
strings.setup.title: Make yourself at home
strings.setup.body: These preferences stay with you the next time you open AI Home.
strings.next.title: What comes next
strings.next.providers.body: Set up provider connections above in the desktop app.
strings.next.profile.body: Profile setup and conversations follow in 4B-2. Your agent identity will stay separate from its API key.
strings.next.memory.body: Scribe and versioned memory follow in 4B-3 and 4B-4. The working memory starts at 300 tokens.
strings.side.title: Your foundation
strings.side.note: Connection tests only fetch model lists. Conversations are not implemented yet.
strings.error.title: Unable to complete this action
strings.error.revision_conflict: Saved settings changed elsewhere. Current data has been refreshed; try again.
strings.error.storage_error: Data could not be read or saved. Your last saved settings have been kept.
strings.error.unknown_command: This action is not available yet.
strings.error.unsupported_contract_version: The application components use incompatible versions.
strings.error.idempotency_conflict: This request identifier was already used for another action.
strings.error.transport: The desktop connection is unavailable. Try opening AI Home again.
strings.error.pack_invalid: The language or appearance pack is invalid.
strings.error.event_gap: Event history is incomplete. Reload the current state.
strings.config.title: Connect your AI
strings.config.body: Create profiles, store an API key in your system vault and test access to the provider model list. Conversations follow in the next stage.
strings.config.preview: Connection setup requires the desktop app. This browser preview does not store keys or call providers.
strings.config.name: New profile name
strings.config.label: Connection label
strings.config.keyNotice: The key is sent only to the native app and system vault. After changing provider or endpoint, save the connection and enter the key again.
strings.config.saved: Saved. Test the connection before assigning models.
strings.config.unsaved: Unsaved settings — the test uses the saved connection
strings.error.profile_scope_mismatch: This action requires the correct profile scope.
strings.error.not_found: The record is unavailable in this profile.
strings.error.connection_unverified: Test this connection before assigning models.
strings.error.credential_unavailable: The system vault could not save or read this key. Check that it is available and unlocked, then enter the key again.
strings.error.stale_connection_test: The connection changed during the test. Test the saved configuration again.
strings.error.operation_interrupted: The test was interrupted by a restart. Its saved result is available; start a new test if needed.
strings.error.provider_authentication_failed: The provider rejected access. Check the key and permissions.
strings.error.provider_error: The provider request failed or returned invalid data.
strings.error.operation_budget_exceeded: The complete model list exceeded the call budget. No incomplete list was accepted.
strings.error.policy_denied: This action is unavailable for this profile.
strings.error.model_capability_unknown: This model option has not been confirmed.
